title: Content Segmentation

variables.name: type
variables.reason: Separate Movie/TV formats so genre and duration similarities remain interpretable.
variables.treatment: Encode Movie/TV Show; retain separate duration units.

variables.name: country
variables.reason: Production origin adds geographic catalog context to the similarity geometry.
variables.treatment: Tokenize multiple countries; fit vocabulary on the fitting data only.

variables.name: listed_in
variables.reason: Genre overlap is the principal semantic basis for content similarity.
variables.treatment: Tokenize multiple genres; unknown categories do not extend the fitted vocabulary.

variables.name: duration
variables.reason: Separate film length and season counts distinguish formats without mixing units.
variables.treatment: Parse positive minutes for Movies and integer seasons for TV Shows; never treat them as interchangeable.

variables.name: release_year
variables.reason: Measures original release cohort; it is distinct from date added.
variables.treatment: Numeric year; transformation fits within the relevant fitting data.

variables.name: date_added
variables.reason: Catalog-entry timing is outside the intended metadata similarity/advisory task.

variables.name: rating
variables.reason: Advisory ratings are not viewer scores, commercial success or clustering ground truth.
variables.treatment: Never used as a model feature or performance label.

variables.name: director
variables.reason: High cardinality is outside the chosen geometry/time-series feature set.

variables.name: show_id / title
variables.reason: Trace records and remove repeated entities; unique identifiers do not describe generalizable content.
variables.treatment: Exclude from features; title/type/year supports entity review.

decisions.reason: Normalize categorical blocks so a large vocabulary cannot dominate merely by dimension; emphasize genre by design.
decisions.limitation: Weights define similarity and are not learned causal importance.

decisions.reason: A single clustering run cannot establish meaningful structure or stable boundaries.
decisions.evidence: 27 candidates, three seeds each; choose highest eligible mean silhouette in k=2–10.
decisions.limitation: The k=10 winner is at the upper boundary; this does not establish a globally optimal k.

split_strategy: Unsupervised transductive segmentation: all 8,783 entities enter fitting. A fixed 1,500-row sample scores geometric separation; 2D PCA is visualization only, not a test set.
